name: SkillHub
description: Hosts a self-hosted enterprise registry where teams publish, version, review and search agent skill packages, with a CLI.

skills.name: Publish and version skills
skills.description: Publishes agent skill packages with semantic versions to a private, self-hosted registry for your teams.

skills.name: Discover skills
skills.description: Searches published skills by full text with filters by namespace, so teams can find and install them.

skills.name: Review and governance
skills.description: Routes skills through team-admin review within each namespace before they are published.
